statement.p: A town has 3700 registered residents. Among them, 34\% were Democrats, 38\% were Republicans. The rest were Independents. How many registered Independents live in this town?
There are registered Independent residents in this town.

solution.p: Its given there are 34\% Democrats, 38\% Republicans, and the rest are Independents. Now we can use subtraction to find the percentage of registered Independent residents:
So there are 28\% Independents. Now this problem can be boiled down to this question: What is 28\% of 3700? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 28\% of 3700 is x, so 28 out of 100 corresponds to x out of 3700.
We will write and solve the proportion:
There are 1036 registered Independent residents in this town.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem. This translation from English to math may help you remember the percentage formula.
